STEERFORTH’S HOME", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u022-b0062", "target": "Когда вечер уже порядком подошёл к концу и внесли поднос со стаканами и графинами, Стирфорт, сидя у огня, пообещал, что всерьёз подумает о том, чтобы поехать со мной в деревню. Спешить некуда, сказал он; через неделю будет в самый раз; и его мать гостеприимно сказала то же самое. Пока мы разговаривали, он не раз назвал меня Маргариткой, что снова вызвало мисс Дартл на сцену.", "source_sha256": "37897d41210d7bb5a0a9460f75d99c8981aa8a231aaba20a0d2d437767dc1665", "target_id": "ru-en85-u022-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ecec89e442d400d39e1dec2e2a2e8ee13a4f931fad538731303e0f0431b42b7d"}, {"source_id": "en85-u022-b0063", "target": "— Но в самом деле, мистер Копперфилд, — спросила она, — это прозвище? И почему он вас так называет? Это — а? — потому что он считает вас молодым и невинным? Я так глупа в таких вещах.", "source_sha256": "4996fcb3f9207215eab4e004095459186906557f14dfdf226d14a65621c354c2", "target_id": "ru-en85-u022-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "431a2681205bfe694209e8a7fc0266d9467dbb2fd7f0df9b8960aa74d25a23fa"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 20, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u022-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I coloured in replying that I believed it was.", "sha256": "9c806fcfc0d0d9b7ad79f44c1d936c45a5ce1fbaa6785ac602005397f3ca6db3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[27]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u022-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh!’ said Miss Dartle. ‘Now I am glad to know that! I ask for information, and I am glad to know it. He thinks you young and innocent; and so you are his friend. Well, that’s quite delightful!’", "sha256": "8d20074124e7ae14ea0a8367368a5668e7289b4bc7c8503f9cba050dc98dd2f4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[27]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u022-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She went to bed soon after this, and Mrs. Steerforth retired too. Steerforth and I, after lingering for half-an-hour over the fire, talking about Traddles and all the rest of them at old Salem House, went upstairs together. Steerforth’s room was next to mine, and I went in to look at it. It was a picture of comfort, full of easy-chairs, cushions and footstools, worked by his mother’s hand, and with no sort of thing omitted that could help to render it complete. Finally, her handsome features looked down on her darling from a portrait on the wall, as if it were even something to her that her likeness should watch him while he slept.", "sha256": "c7df3c33ed43f55805b56c59df2d6eec36e6fe322a67fd7b11d1619a45ac5344", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[27]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u022-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I found the fire burning clear enough in my room by this time, and the curtains drawn before the windows and round the bed, giving it a very snug appearance. I sat down in a great chair upon the hearth to meditate on my happiness; and had enjoyed the contemplation of it for some time, when I found a likeness of Miss Dartle looking eagerly at me from above the chimney-piece.", "sha256": "14ebd19479d0f52a6742622836803042ba8a21c7537c5a71b2b6c6736ca67bd4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[27]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u022-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was a startling likeness, and necessarily had a startling look. The painter hadn’t made the scar, but I made it; and there it was, coming and going; now confined to the upper lip as I had seen it at dinner, and now showing the whole extent of the wound inflicted by the hammer, as I had seen it when she was passionate.", "sha256": "423865f6f33c06782becf8826ed69cc445ca6bcf135ebfed25f14c033cf69006", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[27]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u022-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I wondered peevishly why they couldn’t put her anywhere else instead of quartering her on me. To get rid of her, I undressed quickly, extinguished my light, and went to bed. But, as I fell asleep, I could not forget that she was still there looking, ‘Is it really, though? I want to know’; and when I awoke in the night, I found that I was uneasily asking all sorts of people in my dreams whether it really was or not—without knowing what I meant.", "sha256": "9549804e81c52c1daaa48d7289eba41135654c4de4e780f8ea8ae1e1db5ee78c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[27]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
